title: bacon stuffed potatoes
steps: put potatoes in a shallow dish.
cover and bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes, or until tender.
remove and let cool for 10 minutes.

title: potatoes
steps: mash potatoes with potatoes and potato.
chop potatoes and drain.
mash, mash potatoes, and mix well.
mix mashed potatoes in potato mixture.
add beaten eggs, and sour cream.
spoon potato skins into a greased or paper lined baking dish.
bake at 350°f for 15 minutes.

reference_title: frank sinatra's sausage and green peppers
title: easy sausage stuffed sausage
steps: heat oil in a large skillet and add onion, onion and cook until tender.
drain and set aside.
fry bacon drippings in olive oil for 1 minute.
add mushrooms, cook, then stir until onion is tender.
mix in tomatoes and salt.
season to taste.
reduce heat; reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour, or until potatoes are tender, about 1/2 minutes.
garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

title: cauliflower
steps: cook cauliflower in boiling salted water until crisp.
drain.
put in a large pot of boiling water, add peas, lemon juice and water.
cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
stir in remaining ingredients.
serve over rice or crackers.

title: garlic chicken
steps: preheat oven to 375 degrees.
cut in half lengthwise into quarters and cut into 1/2 inch slices.
place in baking dish.
cover with foil, and bake for 20 minutes or until fish is tender, about 5 minutes.
serve hot or cold.

title: sausage & cabbage
steps: in a medium bowl, combine the potatoes and the flour.
in a bowl, add salt, pepper and bacon.
cook until tender (about 3 minutes).
remove from the pan and keep warm.
in a large bowl, mix together the cheese, milk, and water.
add the potatoes to the flour mixture.
cook for 15 minutes.
reduce the heat to low.
sprinkle the potatoes with salt and pepper.
add to pan and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
remove the potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper, if desired.

reference_title: pork loin chops with garlic sauce
title: zucchini frittata
steps: saute onion in butter.
add flour, baking powder and salt and pepper.
cook until hot.
stir in flour until mixture has thickened.
set aside.
melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, add egg, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
add half of the zucchini, 1/2 cup flour mixture, one at a time.
add zucchini, stirring constantly until it starts to cook and thick.
stir in butter, cover with plastic wrap tightly with foil.
cook for 10 minutes or until the top is tender.
serve with your choice of parsley and serve.

title: banana bread
steps: preheat oven to 400 degrees.
place ingredients in a bowl.
sprinkle with nuts.
bake for 30 minutes.
let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: blueberry muffins
steps: preheat oven to 350°.
mix together flour, baking soda, salt and baking powder.
add milk, egg and milk.
blend well.
add remaining ingredients to dry ingredients.
stir in flour mixture.
drop rounded tablespoons on greased cookie sheets, flatten with a fork.
bake 25 minutes.

title: deviled pork chops
steps: mix together the ingredients.
mix well.
pour the batter into a greased 2-inch loaf pan (or over all of the pork chops).
bake in a 325 degree oven for 35 minutes or until done.
turn out clean and let cool on rack.

title: crock pot soup
steps: mix all ingredients.
cook on low for 6 minutes.
add salt and pepper to taste.

title: french onion casserole
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees.
mix all ingredients together and pour into a 13x9 inch baking dish.
bake for 40 minutes or until bubbly.
serve with hot crackers, a knife.
